titles.native: おっぱい学園マーチングバンド部!

description:
Based on the erotic game by Marine.

You play an average joe who one day receives a special camera from a mysterious, massively-endowed girl in a bunny suit. This camera has the ability to make any girl photographed with it unbearably horny, deepening their erotic agony with each picture you take. And when the sexual tension finally boils over, the only way to quench these uniformed vixens' thirst is by having them service you with their enormous breasts!

(Source: Visual Novel Database)
